Hi everyone,
My visa was automatically renewed (like many others), and I received an SMS saying that a new appointment will be scheduled.

We are trying to contact Misrad Hapnim at Kiryat HaMemshala to arrange a new appointment, but we’re having trouble reaching them.

Does anyone happen to have a direct email for that office?

We already emailed Mirsham-Tel-Aviv@piba.gov.il but haven’t received a response, can anyone confirm if this is the correct address?

Thank you so much for your help 🙏🏻
